```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| output: false

pacman::p_load("tidyverse", "lubridate", "janitor", "here", "glue", "ggthemes", "forcats", "gt", "reactable", "gtExtras", "gtsummary")
invisible(here::i_am("analysis/nc_cms_deaths.qmd"))

```




```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# for NC, fix the ownership stuff by using our spreadsheet. 

nc_summary <-  readRDS(here("cms_3070g/data/five_year_summary.rds")) |> 
    filter ( state_code == "NC") |> 
    # fix bear creek
    mutate ( fac_group = if_else ( str_detect( name_of_facility, "BEAR CREEK"), "RHA", fac_group) 
    )  



```

## Deaths and allegations 



```{r}
#| label: per-patient-stats

nc_summary |> 
    group_by ( fac_group) |> 
    summarize ( death_rate = (sum(deaths) / sum(median_client_est)  ) , 
                unusual = (sum (deaths_suspect) / sum(median_client_est) ) ,
                allegations_rate = ( sum (allegations) / sum ( median_client_est)) , 
                facilities = n() ,
                pct_severe_disability = (sum(median_sev_prof_id) / sum(median_client_est)  ) , 
                size = mean( median_client_est) |>  round (1)
    )  |> 
    arrange ( fac_group) |> 
    gt( ) |> 
    gt_theme_nytimes() |> 
    fmt_percent( c(death_rate, unusual, allegations_rate, pct_severe_disability), decimals=1) |> 
    tab_header("North Carolina facilities key rates, most recent 5 years") |> 
    cols_label ( death_rate = "Deaths",
                 unusual = "Unusual deaths",
                 allegations_rate = "Allegations of abuse / neglect",
                 facilities = "ICFs", 
                 size = "Median client estimate") |> 
    fmt_number ( c( facilities, size), decimals=0) |> 
    tab_footnote( "Percents of deaths and allegations are the total for 5-years divided by the median number of residents in the latest year")

 
 


```


### Profound and severe intellectual disability profile by type of owner




```{r}
library(ggiraph)

p <- 
  nc_summary |> 
  mutate ( size_group = cut ( median_client_est, breaks=c (-Inf, 6, 25, Inf) , labels = c("Small (up to 6)", "Medium", "Large (Over 25)")), 
             id_severity_score = median_sev_prof_id / median_client_est, 
             severity = cut ( id_severity_score, breaks = c(-Inf, .5, .75, Inf), 
                            labels = c("Low severity", "Medium severity", "High severity")
                        ), 
            tooltip_label = paste0(
                 "Facility: ", name_of_facility, # Assumes a 'facility_name' column, 
                 "\nOwner: ", coalesce( parent_name, "") , 
                 "\nMedian Estimate: ", round(median_client_est, 1),
                "\nDeaths: ", deaths)
            ) |> 
    ggplot ( aes ( x= median_client_est,
                   y = deaths, 
                   color = fac_group, 
                   size=deaths, 
                   tooltip = tooltip_label,
                   data_id = provider_ccn # Use a unique ID for each point) 
                   ) ) + 
    geom_jitter_interactive ( alpha=.8 , hover_nearest=FALSE) + 
    facet_wrap (    ~ severity,  nrow = 3, scales="free") +
    theme_minimal( ) +
    labs ( x = "# residents", y = "5-year deaths", color="Facility type") +
    guides ( size="none") +
    theme(
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
            
            panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey90", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),

            panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines")
  )




girafe(p)


```


(The large for-profit facility is the Caswell Center, which CMS has coded as proprietary, not state-owned)
